data.title: Second reminder from NetzMuster: €49.99 due
data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH sent a second reminder (2. Mahnung) dated 26 March 2026 for the unpaid February 2026 invoice. The total is €49.99 including a €5.00 reminder fee, to be received by 7 April 2026.
data.explanation: Your internet provider says the February 2026 invoice is still unpaid despite an earlier reminder on 12 March 2026. A €5.00 reminder fee was added, so you now owe €49.99. Pay so the money arrives by 7 April 2026, or the provider may block your connection. If you already paid, you can treat the letter as settled, but check your bank statement. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the provider in writing.

items.consequence: The provider reserves the right to block your connection (Sperre des Anschlusses) if payment is delayed further.
